options.name: add_family
options.description: Create IS-IS IPv4 or IPV6 address family and enter IS-IS IPv4 address family view

options.name: cost_style
options.description: Configure the type of IS-IS overhead value, that is, the type of destination path overhead value in the message received and sent by IS-IS.

options.name: level
options.description: Configure the level of the router,the default value is Level-1-2.

options.name: network
options.description: Network entity name of the configuration IS-IS process(X...X.XXXX....XXXX.00)

options.name: preference
options.description: Configure routing priority of IS-IS protocol(1~225),before config it,you need to config add_family first.

options.name: spf_limit
options.description: Indicates that it is allowed to receive a message with a destination path overhead value greater than 1023. If this parameter is not specified, a message with an overhead value greater than 1023 will be discarded. This parameter is optional only when compatible or narrow compatible is specified.
